title: Android 10 in Samsung A80
symptom: After upgrading Samsung A80 from Android 9 to Android 10, xDrip could not connect to the Dexcom G5 transmitter. After following a fix, it connected but when stopping and starting a sensor, it insists on a 2-hour warm-up even after moving the clock back 2 hours. Later, intermittent loss of connection occurred, sometimes taking over an hour to reconnect.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. The user speculates that the problems were related to Android patches, and a factory reset resolved them. The maintainer suggests the warm-up behavior is controlled by the transmitter and cannot be overridden by xDrip.
fix: A factory reset with installation of the latest Android patches resolved all problems. For the warm-up issue, the maintainer states that xDrip cannot override the Dexcom transmitter's warm-up behavior.
evidence_quote: after factory reset ( and installation of the latest android patches ) all problems gone, seems like the problems were related to the Android patches
